name: scrum-ai-ecosystem
description: Subagents for Scrum roles and the development pipeline: developer, product owner, technical writer and general writer sets, each without hooks, plus guard-hook variants of the developer and product owner sets.

plugins.name: su3-developer-set
plugins.description: Subagents for the delivery pipeline: project management, architecture, development, SRE, AI reliability, QC and QA. No hooks.

plugins.name: su3-developer-set-with-guards
plugins.description: The same delivery pipeline agents as su3-developer-set, plus a guard hook that denies or asks before data changes, live infrastructure changes and version upgrades. Install one of the two, not both.

plugins.name: su3-product-owner-set
plugins.description: Subagents for Product Owners: strategy, market research, security maintenance, UI/UX, prototyping and backlog management. No hooks.

plugins.name: su3-product-owner-set-with-guards
plugins.description: The same Product Owner agents as su3-product-owner-set, plus a guard hook for tickets, sprints, version changes and ADRs. Install one of the two, not both.

plugins.name: su3-tech-writer-set
plugins.description: Subagents for technical articles: content scouting, drafting, translation and editorial review.

plugins.name: su3-general-writer-set
plugins.description: Subagents for general-audience writing: drafting, translation and editorial review.
